records.statement: The RIL CLI design describes the CLI as an adapter over shared Reasoning Distiller primitives and orchestration rather than a new semantic or authority layer.
The Human-to-Agent interaction design states that conversation itself grants no authority and creates no semantic operation unavailable through the accepted RIL boundary.
The CLI and Human-to-Agent designs keep proposal creation, approval creation, and application as distinct operations.
Fresh direct approval creation requires proposal-applicability revalidation immediately before the approval is created.
Apply-time validation remains independently mandatory after approval creation, including after grant-derived approval.
A durable workflow identifies one immutable authenticated bounded intent and records progression through immutable append-only workflow events.
Durable workflow intent grants no downstream authority, approval, activation, semantic authority, admission authority, or resource lock.
Workflow auto-advance creates execution eligibility but does not grant authority for the operations it may advance.
A valid materiality pause must interrupt consequential continuation, and an authority grant cannot waive or consume the required acknowledgement.

The Human-to-Agent design defines authority grants as prospective bounded human authority for exact proposal approval issuance inside one immutable workflow, with the grant rather than the agent carrying authority.
The R16-R18 conformance plan records G1 through G10 as passed and the R16-R18 implementation as conformant on main.
The install package contract separates the generic framework-managed .reasoning-distiller tree from project-owned knowledge, authority, policy, activation, evidence, and canonical state.
The canonical installer is a deterministic network-independent local Python CLI; package retrieval and release selection occur outside the installer.
Installer updates fail closed on managed-tree drift and preserve or restore the prior verified installation when validation fails.
Package semantic content identity is distinct from the transport SHA-256 of the exact archive bytes.

The accepted release procedure requires an exact pinned release and source, verification of the published release assets, local installation, offline-capable runtime validation, review of the resulting diff, and normal project governance for the consuming change.

source_context.summary: First curated normative baseline for Reasoning Distiller
